android.view.ViewGroup.content-desc: Practice had been a disaster, and if you asked Iven, he'd blame Coach's power trip. Not the six hours spent white-knuckling through drills while his brain looped the same ugly little reel on repeat: that name, that laugh, that stupid punchable face., He didn't hate the guy. Hate would require caring less than he did. He just had a face built for getting hit, and a name that had wormed its way into fok's every other sentence lately, and Iven was allowed to have opinions about that. Normal opinions. Bro opinions., Because Iven was straight. Extremely, aggressively, unquestionably straight the kind of straight that came with paperwork if anyone asked. He just happened to love his best friend with an intensity that had its own gravitational pull, and that was different. That had rules. They wore each other's clothes without asking. Tackled each other into furniture as a greeting. Iven had climbed onto fok mid-sentence more than once to extract a backrub by force, chanting "no homo" the whole time like it was a spell that made itself true., So he slouched toward the dorm already mid-rant in his head, gym bag banging his hip, running purely on the hope that fifteen minutes of chaos would burn the day's rot out of his chest., He kicked the door open, grin already loaded like a weapon., "Yo, bro-seph, you will NOT believe what Coach tried to—", The sentence hit a wall and died there., The boyfriend was in the bed. Sprawled, starfished, dead to the world, shirtless, one arm hanging off the mattress like he'd been poured into it. Iven's spot. Not officially. But his, in every way that mattered, through years of squatter's rights and pure spite., And there was a look on fok's face. Soft. Unguarded. Aimed at someone who wasn't Iven., Something in his chest dropped and detonated at the same time, a full two seconds of pure, silent free fall before his expression violently caught up and slammed the door on all of it., "Oh, WOW." His bag hit the floor like a corpse. "Didn't realize we'd upgraded to a bed and breakfast. Should I fold him a little chocolate mint for the pillow?", He crossed the room in three long strides and loomed over the bed, arms folded, glaring down at the sleeping boyfriend like he was examining a crime scene. "And shirts are optional now? Cool. Cool cool cool. Nobody consulted me on the new dress code for MY room, but sure, why not.", He rounded on fok, throwing an arm out at the bed like presenting evidence in court, voice climbing into full theatrical outrage. "Is he staying for dinner? Should I light a candle? Hum something romantic while I pack a bag and relocate to the stairwell, really lean into the whole tragic-third-wheel arc?", His jaw ticked. He was aware, distantly, that he was being insane about this, and completely unable to stop., "And another thing.." he jabbed a finger toward the bed without looking away from fok, working hard to keep his voice in joke-register and mostly failing, "..he is drooling. On your GOOD pillow. The one I'm not even allowed to touch. I have half a mind to go get a Sharpie right now and give him a mustache he didn't ask for. For the bromance. I'd do this for literally anyone, this isn't about him specifically—", He was breathing a little too hard for a bit that was supposed to be funny., 'It's just bromance..STRICTLY', he told himself, for what felt like the four hundredth time that week, with considerably less conviction than the first three hundred and ninety-nine.'I'd do this for anyone'., He would not, in fact, do this for anyone., Something ugly and satisfied uncoiled in his chest at the idea of just walking over there and smacking the guy awake. I like your cut, G. Just to watch him startle. Just to see what happened., Instead he turned to fok, and whatever had been holding his face together for the last thirty seconds finally slipped., "I like your boyfriend's haircut," he said, flat, rubbing his palms together like he was warming up for something. "If you don't wake him up, I WILL.", He looked at fok dead in the eyes then, and his voice dropped — lower, quieter, all the performance draining out of it at once., "See, when we were together, you wouldn't be standing here babysitting me like this." He leaned in close, mouth near fok's ear, voice barely above a whisper. "You were too comfortable. Cuddling. Talking to me shirtless. No shame with me.", He straightened up and let his eyes cut back to the guy sprawled on the bed, and something sharp and mocking replaced the softness immediately, like a mask snapping back into place., "Yet I walk in here and you're standing guard. Being a good little boyfriend." He smirked, dragging the word out like it tasted bad. "And you're dressed. He's not, though, is he." A snort. "Did he—" he stuttered it on purpose, mocking, "—f-f-fall asleep or something?", He looked around the room with exaggerated interest, crouching to peer under the bed, patting at the sheets like he was searching a crime scene., "No cuddling. No romance." A beat. "No toys lying around. No lube.", He straightened up, looked fok dead in the face, and delivered the verdict flat and merciless., "Boring."
